messages:
nora (product): Pilot onboarding ask from VitaHealth: tenant-scoped Optimize alpha. They want: quant recommendation API, nightly eval alerts on their clinical prompts, and an auditable JSON record. No auto-applications.

sam (swe): We should keep alpha API-only, Dedicated eu. Reuse eval-runner; feature-flag per tenant. Est: ~2 sprints for 1 SWE.

faye (ml): ML flow (compact): sample ~1k prompts, run baseline + 3 quant candidates, score by clinical F1 + ppl, surface top-2 with p50/p95/p99 lat estimates. Trigger when F1 drops >=1.5% or ppl+latency combo shows win.

eli (solutions): Compliance needs exportable audit record with baseline_eval_id, new_eval_id, recommended_quant, metric_deltas, and a short rationale. Also tenant opt-out must be explicit.

sam (swe): Alert delivery targets: emit event <10m, deliver to internal ops channel, customer webhook, and email. Alpha: advisory-only payload JSON, no UI.

nora (product): Proposed acceptance: nightly evals persist; alerts produced and delivered <10m; audit record stored and exportable; opt-out respected; docs + runbook. Approve alpha scope? React :thumbsup:/:thumbsdown:.

faye (ml): :thumbsup: will prepare eval set and thresholds.

sam (swe): :thumbsup: will open eng ticket and branch.

ci-bot: Created branch feature/optimize-vitahealth-alpha. CI started.
